tables.name: bronze_taxi_zones
tables.comment: TLC taxi zone lookup: maps each location ID to its borough and zone name.

columns.name: location_id
columns.comment: Taxi zone ID (matches the pickup and dropoff location IDs).

columns.name: borough
columns.comment: NYC borough of the zone. Special values include EWR (Newark airport), N/A and Unknown.

columns.name: zone
columns.comment: Name of the taxi zone.

columns.name: service_zone
columns.comment: Service zone grouping of the taxi zone, such as Yellow Zone or Airports.

tables.name: bronze_yellow_trips
tables.comment: Raw NYC yellow taxi trips exactly as published by the TLC, one row per trip. Only column types and names are normalised and lineage columns added. Partitioned by source_month.

columns.name: VendorID
columns.comment: Code for the technology provider that supplied the trip record.

columns.name: tpep_pickup_datetime
columns.comment: Date and time the meter was engaged (trip start).

columns.name: tpep_dropoff_datetime
columns.comment: Date and time the meter was disengaged (trip end).

columns.name: passenger_count
columns.comment: Number of passengers, entered by the driver. Often missing or zero in raw data.

columns.name: trip_distance
columns.comment: Trip distance in miles reported by the taximeter.

columns.name: RatecodeID
columns.comment: Final rate code for the trip, for example standard rate or airport rates.

columns.name: store_and_fwd_flag
columns.comment: Y if the record was held in the vehicle memory before being sent because there was no connection, otherwise N.

columns.name: PULocationID
columns.comment: Taxi zone ID where the meter was engaged (pickup).

columns.name: DOLocationID
columns.comment: Taxi zone ID where the meter was disengaged (dropoff).

columns.name: payment_type
columns.comment: How the passenger paid: 0 flex fare, 1 credit card, 2 cash, 3 no charge, 4 dispute, 5 unknown, 6 voided trip.

columns.name: fare_amount
columns.comment: Time and distance fare calculated by the meter, in US dollars.

columns.name: extra
columns.comment: Miscellaneous extras and surcharges, such as rush hour and overnight charges.

columns.name: mta_tax
columns.comment: Tax charged by the metered rate.

columns.name: tip_amount
columns.comment: Tip in US dollars. Filled in automatically for card payments; cash tips are not included.

columns.name: tolls_amount
columns.comment: Total of all tolls paid during the trip.

columns.name: improvement_surcharge
columns.comment: Surcharge assessed at the start of the trip.

columns.name: total_amount
columns.comment: Total charged to the passenger in US dollars. Cash tips are not included.

columns.name: congestion_surcharge
columns.comment: Total collected for the New York State congestion surcharge.

columns.name: airport_fee
columns.comment: Fee for pickups at the airports where it applies.

columns.name: source_month
columns.comment: Month of the TLC file the row came from, in YYYY-MM format.

columns.name: source_file
columns.comment: Name of the TLC file the row came from.

columns.name: ingested_at
columns.comment: Timestamp when the row was loaded into bronze.

tables.name: gold_cube_daily
tables.comment: Additive cube for the dashboard: one row per date, pickup borough and payment type. Holds sums and counts so any filter can be recomputed.

columns.name: pickup_date
columns.comment: Calendar date of the pickup.

columns.name: borough
columns.comment: NYC borough of the zone. Special values include EWR (Newark airport), N/A and Unknown.

columns.name: payment
columns.comment: Payment type as a readable label, such as Credit card or Cash.

columns.name: trips
columns.comment: Number of trips.

columns.name: fare_sum
columns.comment: Sum of fare_amount over the trips in the row, in US dollars.

columns.name: total_sum
columns.comment: Sum of total_amount over the trips in the row, in US dollars.

columns.name: distance_sum
columns.comment: Sum of trip distance in miles over the trips in the row.

columns.name: minutes_sum
columns.comment: Sum of trip minutes over the trips in the row.

columns.name: card_fare_sum
columns.comment: Sum of fares for card-paid trips only (the denominator of tip percentage).

columns.name: card_tip_sum
columns.comment: Sum of tips for card-paid trips only (the numerator of tip percentage).

tables.name: gold_quality_report
tables.comment: How many rows failed each quality rule, out of all rows ingested.

columns.name: rule
columns.comment: Name of the quality rule.

columns.comment: Number of rows that failed the rule. A row can fail several rules.
